programme.title: March (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: As northern forests become carpeted by bluebells and wood anemones, and damp corners become singles bars for frogs and a toads, hailing the first hint of spring sun, South Africa needs a break from the heat, fire season is in full swing, threatening the fynbos and the extraordinary animals living in them. Ground squirrels get inventive to find shade. Gray whales migrate up the Californian coast, passing colonies of sea otters. March is a month of change

programme.title: Wild Uruguay
programme.desc: Uruguay's biodiversity is surprisingly greater than one would expect. We will find out why as we embark on a journey through its ecosystems and landscapes to discover its fauna. Today we know that Uruguay is more than just the outermost edge of the Pampas, as the country holds a range of ecosystems. Within its borders, species of the Pampas come face to face with species of the Atlantic Forest, the Misiones rainforest, and the Chaco forest, giving rise to unexpected encounters.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: The story of Europe's living waters begins at great altitude. Melt waters from the highest snow-capped peaks feed some of the greatest rivers. On their relentless downward journey, streams and rivers have carved through all of Europe's greatest landscapes. Gorges, lakes and wetlands are home to an incredible array of wildlife and seas and oceans have sculpted a coastline of endless variety.

programme.title: Hidden Australia
programme.desc: Sometimes called the biggest island on Earth, Australia is a subcontinent of incredible diversity, beauty, danger and downright weirdness.

programme.title: Sexy Beasts
programme.desc: Driven by surging hormones, every creature on the planet, big or small, will do whatever it takes to find and secure a mate. For some this will take the fight of their lives, while others must preen, prance and party their way to success. From one night stands and group sex to lifelong love and unbreakable bonds, when it comes to finding a mate the animal kingdom has it all. The need to breed manifests itself in all sorts of wonderful antics, displays and behaviours.

programme.title: Hidden Russia
programme.desc: There's no doubt Russia has it all: from the subtropics to the arctic and the Atlantic to the Pacific; giant lakes, active volcanoes and endless forests.

programme.title: Wildest Places: Australia
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: One of Australia's most remarkable natural gifts. The Great Barrier Reef in all it's breath-taking beauty. It is the world's largest coral reef, acknowledged as one of the seven wonders of the natural world, and viewed from a greater distance it's easy to understand why. It is larger than the Great Wall of China and the only living thing on earth visible from space. The Great Barrier Reef supports a vast array of life forms.

programme.title: April (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: aster, a time of babies, easter eggs are everywhere as birds get busy breeding, lambs dance around fields and cute baby bunnies emerge from their borrows. Migrants like ospreys and puffins return to their breeding sites. Migrants can come in all shapes and sizes and for different reasons. Hammerhead sharks swarm around Galapagos and take advantage of cleaning services on the reef.

programme.title: Seals - Clowns of the Sea
programme.desc: Much loved clowns of the sea, seals are endlessly fascinating. Even though they're not much more than bloated sausages on land, they're agile hunters and supremely graceful in the water. They en-tertain us with dramatic courtships, an endlessly playful sense of curiosity and some of the cutest babies on the planet.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: This episode will introduce you to some of the Aquariums most weird and wonderful inhabitants. From upside-down Jellyfish to male Seahorses giving birth, these wacky residents make up the enchanting world that keeps guests coming to through the Aquarium doors! But other pressing issues keep the staff busy, from keeping the peace between man and seal, to preparing a new gigantic predator tank, there's not a minute to rest in the life of an Aquarist!

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage is home to hundreds of black bears. And it's these black bears, that are patrolling the city. With their brains, their brawn and their cunning, these bears have mastered life in this urban jungle. When Spring arrives the bears hit the city as it's time to start eating. And these bears have found a source of food that is much easier to catch than a slippery salmon - it's trash. And it is everywhere. The city's bins and dumpsters have become the perfect bear restaurant.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: This episode will introduce you to some of the Aquariums most weird and wonderful inhabitants. From upside-down Jellyfish to male Seahorses giving birth, these wacky residents make up the enchanting world that keeps guests coming to through the Aquarium doors! But other pressing issues keep the staff busy, from keeping the peace between man and seal, to preparing a new gigantic predator tank, there's not a minute to rest in the life of an Aquarist!

programme.title: Hidden UK
programme.desc: For its tiny size the UK is a hugely varied landscape with a surprising collection of remarkable and awe-inspiring wildlife.

programme.title: Animal Record Breakers
programme.desc: We love to measure aspects of life at its extremes. The biggest, the tallest, heaviest, fastest, slowest - even the rarest. The creatures that hold the records for these categories are some of the most interesting in the natural world. Some are familiar and iconic, but it's also important to recognise some of the more surprising record breakers. These quirky and unusual animals that often go ignored are inventive, ingenious and awe-inspiring.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: The poaching of rhinos for their horn has brought these animals to the brink of extinction. Namibia's black rhinos are hard to find. The Save The Rhino Trust has been fighting for the protection of the pachyderms every day for 30 years under the most adverse conditions. Hannah Emde accompanies the anti-poaching unit through the semi-desert for a day. She learns how difficult it is to track the animals and can hardly believe her luck when she finds a mother with her calf.

programme.title: Seals - Clowns of the Sea
programme.desc: Much loved clowns of the sea, seals are endlessly fascinating. Even though they're not much more than bloated sausages on land, they're agile hunters and supremely graceful in the water. They en-tertain us with dramatic courtships, an endlessly playful sense of curiosity and some of the cutest babies on the planet.

programme.title: Wild Wolverine
programme.desc: To many the wolverine is the stuff of movie superheroes. To others they are a creature of myth and legend. They look like a weird hybrid between wolf, bear and skunk and are some of the toughest, strongest and most aggressive animals around. In the sub-arctic forests of Siberia survival is an expert skill. The creatures of the far north strike a delicate balance and must show ingenuity and cunning if they are to survive.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: This city spends most of the year encased in ice...but when summer hits, Anchorage bursts into life. Animals and plants living this far north have been forced to adapt, working faster to make the most of the short season, but these animals built to withstand Alaska's extreme winters, often struggle in Anchorage's summer heat! Temperatures can be surprisingly high, with average July highs of 26 degrees C. 300,000 people live alongside these wild animals in the ever growing city of Anchorage.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Caribbean has been shaped by millions of years of unstoppable volcanic forces and ferocious hurricanes, creating a network of 7,000 islands, each one more unique than the next. From islets only a few miles long to landmasses with towering peaks, the habitats of this tropical paradise range from lush rainforests hiding untold species to multi-coloured coral reefs teeming with marine life.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: It's a miracle the first seafarers ever found the Cook Islands/ Kūki 'Airani scattered across two million square kilometres of the Pacific Ocean. But every year, these tropical islands become the destination for over three thousand Humpback whales who've undertaken one of the longest migrations on the planet. They come here to socialise, mate, and raise their young.

programme.title: Secret Life of Baby Owls
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: Hunters of the Forest
programme.desc: Forests are dark, shady habitats, realms of shadows perfect for predators to lurk. The dense plant growth facilitates a wealth of prey species, and cunning predators of all shapes and sizes have adapted to exploit every niche. Whether crawling on the forest floor, gliding through the trees or stalking the shadows in between, hunters have mastered the terrain in every type of forest imagina-ble.

programme.title: Rhino Orphanage
programme.desc: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage. She's not the only newby as Nox the bushbaby, and new volunteers are around to keep her company.

programme.title: Destination Wild: Wild Madagascar
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, hundreds of castaway creatures crash-landed on Madagascar's rugged shores. Isolated from the mainland, evolution went into overdrive. Of almost a quarter of a million species found on the island are unique. This myriad of bizarre life forms had a huge impact on the early human settlers - one particular group of primates shaped their culture, fuelling folklore and legend that still guides their lives today. Limited Rights Available: Worldwide, Free TV Only

programme.title: Nature's Cutest
programme.desc: As we all know the natural world can be tough and challenging at times, but it can also be nothing short of adorable. Fluffy white seals, wobbly-kneed fawns, playing polar bear cubs, adorable teddy bear-like koalas - so much cute it would be impossible to decide which was the most adorable. But why do we consider some animals cute and others not? What it is about them that makes us fall in love? Perhaps it's those animals that remind us of ourselves?

programme.title: Marine Mammals - Born to Swim
programme.desc: Every year some 15 million of us around the world cram onto little boats and head out onto the ocean, hoping for the encounter of a lifetime. For centuries whales and dolphins seem to have reached out to us, capturing our imaginations and our souls. Despite their popularity, much of their lives remain a mystery, taking place beneath the waves and beyond our reach.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Between the continents of North and South America is a tropical paradise: the Caribbean. This archipelago of over 7,000 islands and reefs lies within the crystal clear waters of the Caribbean Sea. From just a few metres wide, to hundreds of kilometres across, every island is different, and each has its own unique wildlife.
programme.sub-title: The Caribbean: The Wild Side of Paradise

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: There are more Caribou in Alaska than people! Across the Arctic, they're the lifeblood of many remote communities. But human expansion, and wild predators, have led to their rapid decline. Out on the tundra, Caribou are the prey of choice for Alaska's carnivores, and at a ranch on the edge of Anchorage, the reindeer are at constant risk from the area's wolves and brown bears. The people of Anchorage have vowed to protect them, but will their help be enough for the Caribou to survive?

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: One of Alaska's most secretive and efficient predators, Lynx are usually highly elusive... but in Anchorage, houses are being built in the Lynx's territory, forcing these usually shy big cats, to find new ways to survive on the streets. As this urban jungle continues to expand into the wilderness, encounters between people and wild Lynx are on the rise. In this wild city, can people live side by side with Alaska's deadliest big cat?

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Chiribiquete is an unknown world, hidden deep within Colombia's Amazon. Pre-historic towers, waterfalls and deep canyons lie surrounded by rivers, lakes and rainforests bursting with life. Scientists have only guessed at what else lies beneath this impenetrable pristine jungle - until now. Biologist Blanca Huertas from England's Natural History Museum, and Colombian-born nature photographer Francisco Forero, head deep into the heart of nowhere.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf lies on the doorstep of New Zealand's largest city. Every summer millions of visitors from the tropics converge here, all lured by a unique seasonal smorgasbord. Giant oceanic manta rays, rarely filmed in these waters, glide into the gulf. Bryde's whales are also primed for the feasting season, alongside common dolphins, and bronze whaler sharks. In the sky above rare black petrels stalk the dolphins to survive.
programme.sub-title: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: The culture of Japan is incredible. But there are also more than 130 mammals and 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: One of Australia's most remarkable natural gifts. The Great Barrier Reef in all it's breath-taking beauty. It is the world's largest coral reef, acknowledged as one of the seven wonders of the natural world, and viewed from a greater distance it's easy to understand why. It is larger than the Great Wall of China and the only living thing on earth visible from space. The Great Barrier Reef supports a vast array of life forms.

programme.title: Wildest Places: Australia
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: Destination Wild - India's Lost Worlds
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are amongst some of the most biodiverse regions in the world, and these mountains are the ancestral birthplace for many of India's endemic species. This episode delves into India's jungle heart, and the mysterious forests nestled in the shadow of the Western Ghats' great peaks. Amongst these trees lies the fabled world from the pages of history, and the character counterparts to the West's most cherished tales of India - Rudyard Kipling's 'The Jungle Book'.

programme.title: Urban Warrirors
programme.desc: As human populations grow, so does our footprint, and more of the natural world is gradually paved over, displacing animals from their natural homes. It presents a staggering number of difficulties for those creatures that find themselves cut off from their natural habitat, but there is a growing band of urban warriors stepping up to the challenge. City life for some means living on the breadline, while others discover a land of opportunity - a new concrete frontier.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: In nature, competition for territory is so extreme that some animals have resorted to living in incredible hostile conditions. From brutal cold, to extreme heat, from the ocean depths, to the driest of deserts, this episode showcases some incredible survival stories in the world's most inhospitable environments.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: On the doorstep of one of the country's biggest cities, Muaūpoko /Otago Peninsula provides a breeding refuge for birds and marine mammals. Northern royal albatrosses return here every year to raise their chicks at the world's only mainland colony. On sheltered beaches around the Peninsula, once hunted from these shores, New Zealand sea lions are returning to form a breeding colony after an absence of centuries.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: Many animals have evolved chemicals to enhance their chance of survival: some scorpions literally drug their potential mates, others use their poisons to defend or kill. The world of venoms and poisons, the apparatus designed to deliver the payload and the strategies that animals employ to use them most effectively is a rich and varied example of natural selection and evolution in action.

programme.title: Manatees on the Move
programme.desc: Manatees, sea cows, these gentle giants go by several names. They were once thought to be beautiful mermaids that could lure sailors to their deaths, though they probably won't win too many beauty contests. To retain their weight, manatees need to eat for 8 hours and consume 8% of their bodyweight every day. And keeping eating also means keeping moving - but though always on the move they're not exactly speedy.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage is home to a huge number of wild porcupines, living in the city's parks, gardens and streets. Almost twice the average size, Anchorage's porcupines search for food here in the city, and find refuge during the bitter Alaskan winters. But life on the streets also takes its toll.Porcupines are the city's number one roadkill. In the wild, few animals other than wolves attempt to kill porcupines, and in the city, domesticated dogs can be as big a threat to the porcupines as wild wolves.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying just off the coast of west Scotland, the Hebrides archipelago is made up of more than 500 islands and islets. Isolation from the mainland has made it the perfect breeding ground for millions of creatures, making it home to some of the largest gatherings, and greatest spectacles on the planet.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: 96% of Egypt's lands are sun-blistered desert. Rock and sand dominate this country, creating a beautiful but hostile environment. Yet it was home to the Worlds greatest ancient civilisation, which flourished for millennia and still captivates us today. These harsh lands also hold amazing animals that can survive and even thrive, able to cope with and profit from the searing temperatures and lack of moisture.

programme.title: July (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: As schools break up for summer and kids can play in meadows amid poppies and singing sky larks, wildlife around the world has very different stories to tell. Lemmings are going crazy. On the Arctic tundra, the ground's frozen for most of the year, now they need to make the most of the time of plenty. But the giving summer heat is too much in southern Spain, where pools are drying out leaving fish high and dry, a feast for herons.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage has a rather unique resident who is renowned as nature's lumberjack and North Americas largest rodent, the beaver. With their powerful teeth the trees they fell can be huge and their dams can be so enormous they can be seen from space. But since humans arrived here, many beavers have been forced to live in an urban jungle! And as the Wild City of Anchorage expands, that means more people, more cars, and the biggest risk to the beavers, dogs!

programme.title: Forest High Life
programme.desc: Who doesn't love a peaceful, relaxing walk in the woods? A green bath in nature, one that some-times leads to exciting glimpses of wild animals going about their daily lives. But no matter how hard we look, we are missing the action; it goes right over our heads - literally! The leafy shade that makes forests so cool, shady and relaxing also hides a vast community head and shoulders above the rest. But this is the canopy, a habitat that holds the most wonderful animal diversity.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Aldabra Tortoise, Matriarch Elephants, Kittiwakes, Honey Bees, Hydra, Lions In this episode of Aging in the Wild, we explore the physiological secrets and factors that determine life expectancy in various animal species. From the seventy-year-old elephant to the quasi-immortal hydra, and the more than a hundred-year-old tortoise, we explore life expectancy, longevity and senescence. Can we distinguish between the effects of the environment and the internal adaptations that lead to longevity?

programme.title: Nature's Oddballs - Creatures of the Night
programme.desc: hile we sleep comfortably in our beds, one of the most spectacular groups of animals go to work - prepare to meet the creatures of the night!

programme.title: Elephants - Changing Lives
programme.desc: Living for over half a century, elephants see the world change around them as they grow. They say an elephant never forgets; if we could enter the massive brain of a veteran elephant, what would we see? Imagine one elephant to represent them all, giving us a unique glimpse into the remarkable life of these magnificent giants.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Life in the Sea
programme.desc: Our planet is one of oceans, and it was this great mass of water that gave birth to Earth's greatest creation - life

programme.title: These Birds Are Made For Walking
programme.desc: Few things are more wondrous than the gift of flight, but some birds have chosen to give it up - the question is, why? Whether it's to save energy, tap into new food resources or invest in other skills, they all have their reasons. But one thing's for sure: it doesn't make flightless birds any less weird and wonderful. There are 60 species of bird that have given up the gift of flight, but they are not all related. Each have taken their own evolutionary path.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: This episode explores nature's deadliest killers. From a tiny but deadly insect, to a pod of hungry Orca's, predators come in all sizes, and are found on every continent on earth. Chasing, stalking, ambushing or using camouflage, the way each predator hunts, catches and kills food is determined by many factors, including the anatomical adaptations of both the predator and the prey.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines a conspiracy that may be seeking to eradicate 90% of the world's population. It looks at the Georgia Guidestones built by an unknown architect which call for humanity to reduce its population to below 500 million.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines whether the United State military has constructed flying saucers. It looks at unclassified documents describing Project 1794 and a supersonic large disk fighter aircraft. These plans are later developed by a Canadian company Avro Aircraft into the Avrocar.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: The end is near. There have been signs and prophecies for centuries but it does feel like man's time on this planet is almost over. The question is: are you ready for Doomsday?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Mars is the key focus of humanity's expansion into space right now. Millions of years ago the Red Planet had a lot in common with Earth, but it's now a desert wasteland. Do the doorways recently discovered on the planet's surface lead to an existential lesson for our species?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Certain structures on our planet have stood the test of time and continue to astonish mankind. So much so, that alien intervention in their construction thousands of years ago, has yet to be ruled out.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: In July of 2023, David Grusch, a former high ranking US Intelligence officer testified to a US government Oversight Committee that there are alien spacecraft located at secret facilities in the US.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Some places in the world, record more UAP sightings than the rest. So many so, in fact, that people flock from all over the world just for the chance to glimpse a flying saucer.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: As the Fermi Paradox states, the possibilities that there is advanced life in the universe is surprisingly high. And if the universe is so old, why haven't we had any contact with extraterrestrial life?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: There is physical evidence of alien activity that has been hidden from the public for years. It is starting to be revealed.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: It is likely that aliens exist in a universe as large as ours. How would they navigate those vast distances and potentially visit us on earth?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: There are three types of close encounters, sightings, fleeting interactions, aliens taking humans for extended periods. We meet real people who have experienced alien life up close.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Several US presidents throughout history have described encounters with UAPs. Is there already an agreement in place between our world leaders and intelligent alien life? And if so, who is keeping that information from the public and why?

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: Places for contact (by appointment): There are places on the planet where contact with these supposed entities that come from other worlds turns out to be more intense than in other places; And it has been like that for thousands of years.

programme.title: Secrets of UFOs
programme.desc: Crop circles have been reported around the globe for more than a century. They appear usually in complete darkness and often instantaneously. Some are clearly hoaxes. Others are inexplicable, with no evidence of human activity. This program asks questions like why do crops undergo changes at the cellular level and what are the strange lights seen over the fields where crop circles are found?

programme.title: Crop Circles: The Mayan Codes Revealed
programme.desc: The Mayan calendar is known and studied by dozens of researches. In fact, many believe it holds a prophetic message, however, its decoding is not yet complete. The mayas were convinced that time is cyclic. Every 5,125 years, an ear would end simultaneously opening a new one. Is it possible that an incredible connection is concealed between the Mayan prophecies and the crop circles?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: According to physics, time travel is possible. So could it be that UAPs aren't coming from somewhere else, but from some when else. Could these UAPs be us, from the future?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler set out to conquer the world and he nearly succeeded. But did the Nazis have help from an extraterrestrial source? We'll tell you what Hitler may have been hiding, and where it is now.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: They live and work in your town. In fact, they may be members of your country's government. But they're not who, or what, they appear to be. We'll unseal the truth about these aliens among us and tell you who has come in peace, and who has a far more sinister purpose in mind.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: A mysterious photograph with no plausible explanation. An aborted nuclear launch half a world away. And the continuing appearance of mysterious men in black. What happens when scientific explanations fail us? Could this shocking photo from the 1960's be the proof we're looking for?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: U.S. Presidents are the most powerful men on the planet. But do they know something about extraterrestrials that we don't? We'll explore the complex relationship between Aliens and Presidents.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Many people believe we are not alone. But if aliens share this planet, what are their plans for us? We'll unseal the Top 10 Alien Plots and let you know if ET came in peace or if he has something else in mind.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: As the Curiosity Rover searches Mars for signs of life, the question becomes: Could Mars have been first? We'll explore the shocking possibility that sentient life began on Mars and traveled here.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Barrow Green H17 Anti-Aircraft Battery was built to protect the Liverpool Docks. I also acted as a general area and a former prisoner of war camp, and holds some sinister secrets and Ghost Dimension uncover paranormal activity dating back to WW2.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team travel to Derbyshire to investigate the New Mills Arts Theatre. This quirky little building has played host to many famous acts and world renowned plays but has a little known secret that it's allegedly Haunted. With unexplained voices coming from the auditorium and shadows witnessed on the stage, The activity will get so intense it will leave the team in a spin!
programme.sub-title: Haunting of New Mills Art Theatre Part 1

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Located in Gran Canaria, there is one house that locals refuse to enter and that is, The House of Fear. Ghostly shadows, loud banging and demonic voices have all been reported here and the Ghost Dimension team will investigate these claims tonight.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Danny Moss has been charged with investigating a haunted house in Middlesbrough in the UK. Rose grew up in the house in the 1970's and 80s which was believed to have been the site of a fatal fire years earlier. She witnessed her first ghost when she was just 7 years old.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: In 1995, a small UK village was disrupted by a brutal fire that destroyed its town hall. To this day, no culprit has emerged - were otherworldly forces responsible?

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: Malahide, a village in Ireland, has been attached to rumors of reincarnation and near-death experiences. Explore the mystery of Malahide in this episode.
programme.sub-title: Malahide, the Edge of Life and Death

programme.title: The Other Side: Secrets of the Paranormal World
programme.desc: Pre-titles and the explanation of premise for believer and non-believer. Origins of the Devil which has the explainer and discussion with Matteo Borrini/Deborah Hyde. Derren Brown Interview. Ouija Section, explanation. Christopher French interview. Haunting section/explanation, interview with Derren Brown, Uri Geller and Jayne Harris. Controlled experiments.

programme.title: The Other Side: Secrets of the Paranormal World
programme.desc: A 30 seconds reminder 'last time' American section; visiting Ralph Sarchie, ex NY cop turned Demonologist and Evangelist Exorcist 'Bob Larsson'. This will include explanation of exorcism and also shots from private exorcism sessions. A cut down of pre-titles and titles then. This will be between me and Matthew.

programme.title: The British UFO Files
programme.desc: The British UFO Files tells a story more bizarre than anything to be found within the pages of even the fictional X Files. Featuring eye-witness accounts by top ranking military personnel, previously top secret documentation and rare archive footage, the film examines information ranging from the alleged production of Nazi UFOs to the landing of an alien spacecraft at a British air-force base.

programme.title: Defeating The Devil
programme.desc: The devil's powers, tactics, objectives and limitations, are discussed by several renowned experts in the field of demonic phenomena, including the most famous of all, Fr. Gabriele Amorth, the Official Exorcist of the Diocese of Rome and author of perhaps the definitive scholarly work on demonology. We discover how the devil works, by using temptation, curses, infestations, hexes and possession.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Can radiation from electrical appliances, power lines, microwave ovens, and wireless technology such as cell phones and baby monitors alter our DNA, cause illness and lead to disease? Richard speaks with a leading researcher on the biological effects of Electro-Magnetic Fields, a retired police officer campaigning to have wireless Internet banned from schools and public places.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Does the Bible contain hidden messages encoded within certain passages of the Old Testament? Is the prophetic nature of these 'codes' proof the Bible's author is of supernatural or extraterrestrial origin? Richard travels to Montreal and Florida to interview several Bible Code researchers who explain why these codes are real, how they can be uncovered and decoded and what they mean for mankind.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: The encounters in the fourth phase are terrible; the witness not only sees the alleged ship or its crew, but is taken, generally unconscious or against their will, into said ships. Some, like Próspera Muñoz, who gave us in her last interview, possibly the most credible abduction account in our story, return to tell what happened. She is not the only one, as we will see in this exciting chapter.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: In Dec 1995-Mar 1996, a surge of UFO sightings occurred, notably at Polvorin of As Gándaras, Lugo. Military witnessed triangle lights on infrared cameras, marking our longest and most prolific UFO event. Cases included landings and encounters with mysterious lights and alleged crews. A year prior, 'something' crashed from space in Cando de Arriba mountains, A Coruña, igniting the phenomenon.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: There is a battle going on for your mind. From the Cold War to the TV set, someone wants to control what you think, how you act and what you believe. We'll reveal the new practices in mind control and tell you why you need to start paying attention before it's too late.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: It seems the world is fascinated with all things science fiction. First it was vampires, then werewolves, and now Zombies. But could this once seemingly far fetched idea be closer to happening then we ever thought possible? Are zombies becoming a reality?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: New developments in science and research have invented equipment that may have much more sinister capabilities than we are being led to believe. Are governments around the world using weather control to incite the next World War and possibly destroy the planet?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: The past few decades have been filled with stunning technological advancement. But is all this 'progress' good for humanity? Animal cloning has been a reality for decades but the disturbing experiments going on behind close doors will shock you. Human cloning may be much closer than you think.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Is this half man, half ape simply a figment of our collective imagination or does he really exist? As the evidence begins to pile up maybe we should be asking: who has been keeping this from us?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: The Great Deceiver. Seducer of the masses. The Bringer of Armageddon. Every culture and religion on the planet believes that an evil one will usher in the end of days. But who is this Anti-Christ? And how can we hope to stop him?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: In 1998 Astronauts captured images of a satellite in Earth's orbit. Is it the same alien object that Nicola Tesla detected in 1899, an alien probe known as the Black Knight? And in 2017 scientists discovered another mysterious satellite from outside our solar system. What could explain Oumuamua's artificial trajectory?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Mars is the key focus of humanity's expansion into space right now. Millions of years ago the Red Planet had a lot in common with Earth, but it's now a desert wasteland. Do the doorways recently discovered on the planet's surface lead to an existential lesson for our species?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: According to physics, time travel is possible. So could it be that UAPs aren't coming from somewhere else, but from some when else. Could these UAPs be us, from the future?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Certain structures on our planet have stood the test of time and continue to astonish mankind. So much so, that alien intervention in their construction thousands of years ago, has yet to be ruled out.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Some places in the world, record more UAP sightings than the rest. So many so, in fact, that people flock from all over the world just for the chance to glimpse a flying saucer.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: UAPs have only recently been witnessed entering the ocean at very high speeds. And since our oceans can be as much as six miles deep, is it possible that some of these UAPs were simply trying to get home?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: As the Fermi Paradox states, the possibilities that there is advanced life in the universe is surprisingly high. And if the universe is so old, why haven't we had any contact with extraterrestrial life?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: There is physical evidence of alien activity that has been hidden from the public for years. It is starting to be revealed.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: There are three types of close encounters, sightings, fleeting interactions, aliens taking humans for extended periods. We meet real people who have experienced alien life up close.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: From military radar to Navy aircraft, sightings of Unidentified Aerial Phenomena have become more frequent of late and been measured on ever more sophisticated technology. It has lead to unprecedented acceptance of alien contact across the globe, including by the US government. What could these visitors be after? Is it the potential energy stored in the Earth's oceans?

programme.title: UFO Diaries
programme.desc: December 9, 1965: the little town of Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, was invaded by military troopers a few hours after the fall of a sky object, which was seen by several townsfolk. Witnesses were forced to keep silent and journalists found that the people with whom they talked told a version different from their first declaration. What fell in Kecksburg?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: We have always been told that mankind enjoys free will. Is this really true? Or have aliens created the means for controlling humanity? The shocking truth might just be hidden inside you.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: 'The Manises Incident' is Spain's most notorious UFO case. A strange luminous body forced a Spanish airliner to emergency land. New recordings and eyewitness testimony shed light on this unforgettable event, including insights from the airport director and radar operator. Pilots, often primary witnesses, share encounters with unidentified flying objects mid-flight.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Since the Jet Age, fighter pilots have been scrambled to intercept UFOs in our skies, but what happens when pilots are sent a Shoot Down Order and can't complete their mission?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: For decades, UFO researchers have demanded that the government reveals what is knows about UFOs. Who will make the announcement? When will they do it? And what will it mean for the very bedrock institutions of society?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: For decades, UFO experts and abductees have reported the strange appearance of ominous investigators appearing out of nowhere after alleged UFO sightings. These frightening authority figures have been dubbed the Men in Black.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: The list of global threats to the human race is long. But could Earth's armed forces be facing a new enemy that is literally out of this world? programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: UFO sightings are a worldwide phenomenon. But for seasoned investigators, ground zero of this explosion was the desert of the American southwest-home to the two greatest UFO hotspots of all time: Roswell, New Mexico and Area 51.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: UFO phenomena occur all over the world, from remote places to the skies over the world's major cities. But if aliens are among us then where are they hiding? programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: All around the world, millions of people from all walks of life are reporting the same thing. Aliens have arrived on Earth. Is this the biggest, most well organized hoax in history? Can millions of witnesses worldwide be wrong? In fact many experts believe, all signs point to a massive global cover-up. We unseal the truth behind the most active alien hotspots on Earth.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: An extraterrestrial threat. A top secret organization. Has the US made contact with aliens? Experts believe they have. And an ultra top secret organization is calling all the shots. Get ready for the untold story of Majestic 12.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Many UFO sightings are solitary events that leave witnesses scrambling to prove their story. But what happens when the same object is seen by many people at the same time? Join us as we expose the hidden secrets of The Kecksburg Incident.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown
programme.desc: Bex and Sean continue their investigation of Norris Green Mansion, a 17th century building believed to hold some of the most haunted spirits in Liverpool.

programme.title: The Past Hunters: Enter the Paranormal
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo

programme.sub-title: Lights Out at Abbey House Museum - Part 2

programme.desc: A 30 seconds reminder 'last time' American section; visiting Ralph Sarchie, ex NY cop turned Demonologist and Evangelist Exorcist 'Bob Larsson'. programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Blue Bell Hill

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: This episode explores the paranormal mysteries surrounding an August 2000 Briton sighting, where police crossed paths with a strange light in the sky.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: St James Cemetery is set behind Liverpool Cathedral and is claimed to be the worlds most haunted, with the remains of over 58,000 people buried at the location and multiple claims of paranormal sightings. programme.sub-title: Witches and Vampires Haunting Saint James Cemetery

programme.desc: Richard examines the fable of the vampire and investigates the possibility that 'demonically reanimated corpses' may in fact exist. programme.title: Ghosts & Witches of Olde England

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: The Old Picture House in Nottingham in the UK, was a cinema abandoned in 1959. Today it houses a museum of haunted artefacts. Steve and Marie have captured what they believe to be paranormal activity on a hearse dating back to the Victorian era. Intrigued by the findings, we have sent MJ Dickson to investigate and validate their claims.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: Unusual activity has been captured on CCTV at an antique centre in Barnsley, UK. It is suspected that a poltergeist may be the culprit. In search of the truth, paranormal investigator Jayne Harris has been despatched to see if she can gather proof for sceptical shop owner Daniel. And in the Paranormal Captured headquarters, footage and stories from around the world are analysed by our experts.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Does the Bible contain hidden messages encoded within certain passages of the Old Testament? Richard travels to Montreal and Florida to interview several Bible Code researchers who explain why these codes are real, how they can be uncovered and decoded and what they mean for mankind.

programme.desc: From the Canary Islands to Galicia, passing through Catalonia, in very special places such as the Cañadas del Teide or on the mountain of Montserrat, witnesses and those contacted assure that UFOs have been making appearances for decades; and they claim to have proof of it!

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: These attacks are the most terrifying part of the phenomenon, and therefore, the most real. Attacks in the middle of the morning, like what happened with Nicolás Sánchez Martín, in Cáceres, or Joan Turu and José Félix Rodríguez, better known as the suicide bombers of Tarrasa, can lead to the death of the witnesses. What is behind these aggressive apparitions?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: What does the American government really know about UFO's? And how far will they go to hide the truth? In 1948 a fireball crashes near Laredo, Texas. They say it was an experimental aircraft. But many experts believe it was a UFO.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: The Soviet Union's vast skies paid witness to thousands of UFO sightings. But the Soviet regime was notorious for secrecy. Many of their encounters reported during the Cold War had potentially deadly consequences for the entire world.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Encountering life from another world can be a terrifying and deadly experience. Abductees claim to have been captured and experimented on. Join us as we confront the truth about alien encounters.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files

programme.desc: The story of two rival toy store owners during Christmas time. Gary, who runs an honest business and has a good relationship with his customers and has everything is running smoothly until he hears of a new bigger store.

programme.desc: A spoiled schoolgirl, her overworked executive mother, and a disillusioned young minister each learns a valuable lesson about community, tradition, and the truest meaning of Christmas from a friendly, but mysterious, drifter named Jess.

programme.desc: There's no such thing as miracles. That's what a skeptical reporter (Kirk Cameron) thought until he met Craig Shergold (Thomas Sangster). Craig is an eight-year-old boy with a brain tumor and less than a year to live. Looking for hope, his mother (Catherine Oxenberg) pushes to break the Guinness World Record for receiving the most get-well cards. They receive an incredible 1.3 million cards and shatter the old record. However Craig continues to get worse.

programme.title: My Son, My Savior
programme.desc: A powerful portrayal of the life of Jesus as seen through the eyes of his mother, Mary. The film imagines Mary's childhood, growing up, celebrating the annual feasts and hearing the prophecies about a coming Messiah who would redeem Israel.

programme.title: Hank's Christmas Wish
programme.desc: "Hank's Christmas Wish" tells the heartwarming tale of a retired elf seeking a life of seclusion. However, his plans are interrupted when a group of unrelentingly cheerful townsfolk, brimming with the holiday spirit, come into his life. Through their unwavering kindness and infectious joy, they help him rediscover the true meaning of Christmas. Packed with yuletide laughter, chestnut-roasting moments, and Jack Frost-nipping faith, this cutesy film captures the essence of the holiday season.

programme.desc: Noah Davis is a Pastor in an affluent community. Depressed after losing his wife to illness, he is contacted by an old friend who has opened a mission in a rough inner city neighborhood. With Christmas approaching, he packs up and together with his two daughters, moves into Salvation Street Mission. Now the family must struggle with the challenges they face in the crime ridden community.

programme.title: Homeless For The Holidays
programme.desc: When an uncaring executive falls from the corporate ladder, he learns how difficult it can be to find work and compassion in today's economy. He eventually accepts a humiliating job, but with bills rapidly piling up, and not enough money to go around, he quickly discovers that, unless something changes soon, he'll lose everything by Christmas. Will family and faith be enough to bring joy when you're Homeless for The Holidays?

programme.desc: The family hold a Christmas party in their home, with guests such Eva Mendes and Brendan Fraser.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: Jack turns 18 and receives a car as a birthday present.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: Ozzy and Sharon fret about all of the time they must spend apart as she works on her talk show.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: Ozzy has a horrible ATV accident while on a promotional tour with Kelly.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: After three weeks in the hospital, Ozzy is released and continues to convalesce at his home in England.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: Kelly annoys everyone, particularly Sharon, with her disgusting lack of personal hygiene.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: Ozzy grows increasingly frustrated about being cooped up around the house.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: Kelly continues to spend time with Rob, but doesn't want to be his girlfriend.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: Ozzy begins suffering from insomnia. He eventually undergoes testing with a sleep disorder expert to determine the cause. Jack gets a tattoo of a cross on his chest, but Ozzy and Sharon do not like it.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: The family tries to decide where to go on vacation. Sharon turns down Fiji because none of the hotels meet her standards, while Ozzy nixes a number of other locations for various reasons.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: Kelly irritates her mother by getting a lip ring. Ozzy and Jack are convinced that Kelly's erratic behaviour and chronic illness are the result of drug use, but Sharon refuses to hear of it. Kelly eventually admits the truth to Sharon and enters rehab. Ozzy and Sharon don't believe she will stay at the facility for long.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: Kelly struggles to adjust to life in rehab, and frequently calls home requesting various personal belongings. She wants to leave, but Jack urges her to tough it out. Jack celebrates both his birthday and a year of sobriety. Kelly arrives home and becomes frustrated by the curfew and other rules she must follow.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: Sharon and Kelly plan a trip to Kenya on behalf of a charity organization. Ozzy doesn't want them to go, as he fears they will be kidnapped or contract malaria. Sharon also has second thoughts after hearing more details about the trip.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: A 25-year-old fan wins a charity auction for the right to spend the day with Sharon. Sharon is touched by the woman's generosity and invites her to spend the night at the Osbourne home. Meanwhile, Jack must attend an online traffic school after getting a speeding ticket.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: Sharon's talk show tapes its final episodes. Feeling mistreated, Sharon clashes with her bosses to the very end, showing up late on purpose and demanding money upfront.

programme.title: The Osbournes
programme.desc: Dr. Phil McGraw pays a visit to the house, where he holds a frank discussion with the Osbournes about drug abuse and other issues that have affected the family's relationships with one another.

programme.title: Deadly Standoffs
programme.desc: The movement for Texas to gain independence splits into factions and takes a dangerous turn. Township of southern Michigan.

programme.title: 72 Hours: True Crime
programme.desc: When a senior citizen is killed on a city street, authorities at first treat it as a typical hit-and-run accident.

programme.title: 72 Hours: True Crime
programme.desc: In 1988, a promiscuous 22-year old boy from the Sikh community has one affair too many and ends up losing his life.

programme.title: Inside Crime Scene
programme.desc: In 2005, Liu Hong Mei's lover chopped up her body into seven parts; in 1989, body of a teenager was found with her head found a metre away from the rest of the body; can modern CSI and forensics techniques piece together to tell a crime process?

programme.title: Autopsy: The Last Hours of...
programme.desc: In 2015 Aaron Hernandez, was convicted of murdering Odin Lloyd, the boyfriend of his fiancée's sister. And at 3:03 am on April 19, 2017, while serving a life sentence, Aaron Hernandez was found dead in his prison cell.

programme.title: Murder Maps
programme.desc: London was rocked by the Blitz from the planes flying above during the WWII and a serial killer was loose on the streets below.

programme.title: Mind Investigators
programme.desc: More than a year after the death of Harmonie Marin, her boyfriend is arrested and accused of her murder.

programme.title: The Interrogation Room Hosted by Vivica A. Fox
programme.desc: Seemingly a kidnapping, Jayden Parkinson's disappearance garnered national headlines after the young teen went missing after telling friends and family she was pregnant.

programme.title: Crimes Uncovered
programme.desc: Seven year-old Sheldean Human disappeared without a trace from her neighbourhood park, leading her community into a frenzied search for her.

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Secret Language of Serial Killers
programme.desc: Investigate the ways in which killers used telephones, letters and other forms of cummunication to harass victim's families and brag to the police.

programme.title: Caught on Bodycam
programme.desc: Raw bodycam footage capturing high-stake police incidents.

programme.title: Caught on Bodycam
programme.desc: Raw bodycam footage capturing high-stake police incidents.

programme.title: Caught on Bodycam
programme.desc: Raw bodycam footage capturing high-stake police incidents.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill
programme.desc: Megan Haines nursed patients at St Andrews Village Nursing Home where she also nursed a lethal grudge. Complaints had been made about the rudeness she'd shown towards patients. Her retaliation? She killed two elderly residents and tried to kill a third. The daughter of one victim, Charli Darragh, gives an emotional interview about the moment she discovered her mother had been murdered.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill
programme.desc: Vickie Dawn Jackson was described as sweet and 'gone to fat' by locals in her small Texas town. Why did Vickie kill off the friends and relatives of those who she knew in Nocona, Texas? Texas journalist Skip Hollandsworth spent time with Nurse Jackson at her Texas jail and reveals the truth about a remarkable, and evil, woman.

programme.title: Under Arrest
programme.desc: Brothers are involved in a bloody stabbing, police force entry to try and stop an assault and investigators are called to a suicide.

programme.title: Crimes That Made History
programme.desc: In August 1933, Violette Nozière, 18, killed her father by poisoning in Paris. After a short period on the run, she was charged with murder and swiftly confessed to the crime, saying her motive was that he abused her. The press and public were immediately fascinated by this patricidal teenager, who became known as "the monster in the skirt".

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: A promising young attorney is shot and killed in a jealous rage by an obsessed, on-again off-again girlfriend.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: The murder of a millionaire doctor's wife sets off a massive manhunt throughout New England.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: For more than a decade, a genius doctor with a homicidal hobby gets away with murder.

programme.title: Deadly Standoffs
programme.desc: Taking viewers to the front lines of America's most deadly and infamous sieges, delving into the stories behind some of the most devastating standoffs in recent US history.

programme.title: Forensics
programme.desc: Twenty year old Emma Louise Agnew doesn't make it to work. Her last text reveals she was meeting someone interested in buying her car. That night her car is found in flames at a local Park close to her place of work.

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives hosted by Nancy Grace
programme.desc: When a beloved young woman is brutally murdered and left in an abandoned house in Brown County, Texas, investigative genetic genealogy could be the key to finding the perpetrator.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: A woman who was convicted of murdering her lover while in a drug induced fight and a woman who killed her grandmother are featured.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: In 1995, when Dr. G worked in Texas, a pile of human bones was found at a supposedly haunted railroad crossing.
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of the Haunted Crossing

programme.title: Gangsters: America's Most Evil
programme.desc: Known as the founder of the notorious Chicago street gang, the Gangster Disciples, Hoover starts one of the first street gangs that was run as a business; while in state prison, Hoover runs a $100 million-a-year drug business.

programme.title: Wardens
programme.desc: This week, game wardens deal with repeat offenders and people with outstanding warrants that only make matters worse when confronted.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7
programme.desc: The team pull together to treat a new raft of emergency patients. They work like a family to face the best and worst of life together. For the team of Barnsley Casualty no two days are ever the same.

programme.title: True Crime Nation with Chris Hansen
programme.desc: Host Chris Hansen and our talented team of veteran crime producers bring you a closer look at the crimes affecting our nation.

programme.title: Crime Time Solvers
programme.desc: Named the "Essonne Serial Killer," the case of Yoni Palmier unfolded swiftly under the vigilant gaze of Versailles police.
programme.sub-title: The Hunt For the Essonne Killer

programme.title: The Lady Killers
programme.desc: A classic love triangle that lasted 16 years led to a shocking murder by Lakhvir Singh in 2009. Her method of killing earned her the nickname 'The Curry Killer' in the press.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: The case of an abused California woman who killed her husband is examined.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: Peggy Darlene Ellis shot her husband of twenty years on New Year's Day.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: San Sebastian, Spain: Tony explores the food-crazed Basque culture. Tony's guide, Chef Luis Irizar, takes Tony into the underworld of Basque gastronomic societies. Later, Tony explores the citys tapas bars.
programme.sub-title: San Sebastian: A Food Lover's Town

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Hanoi, Vietnam: Tony returns to his beloved Vietnam to visit his friend, Linh, for the Vietnamese lunar New Year holiday, Tet. Together, the friends enjoy the holiday and indulge in all the exotic delicacies Vietnamese culture offers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Tony travels to Tokyo where he discovers a radically new cooking attitude. He visits Tokyos largest fresh fish market and is introduced to the culinary diets of Sumo wrestlers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: London, England - In London, Tony attempts to dispel the myth that all English food is disgusting and over-boiled. Tony tries Nose to Tail Eating, explores traditional fare at Pie and Mash Shoppes and then visits a predominantly Indian community.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Kansas City, Kansas, and Houston, Texas, and North Carolina: Which style of barbecue reigns supreme - Kansas City, Houston, or North Carolina? Anthony Bourdain journeys to all three, judging the secrets behind sauces, wood pits, and slow smokers.

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: As a nurse, Coffy (Pam Grier) has seen the ill effects of drugs up close, but it isn't until her little sister becomes addicted to heroin that she finally decides to wage a one-woman battle. Disguised as a prostitute, Coffy goes on a killing rampage, at first going after street dealers and pimps such as sleazy King George (Robert DoQui), then gradually working her way up to bigger honchos. She's shocked, however, when she discovers that her politician boyfriend (Booker Bradshaw) is involved.

programme.title: Foxy Brown
programme.desc: Unable to pay back the $20,000 he owes the mob, small-time hustler Link (Antonio Fargas) instead gives up the identity of an undercover cop (Terry Carter) who happens to be dating his sister, Foxy Brown (Pam Grier). When gangsters later kill the cop, Foxy is quick to make the connection and swears vengeance. Posing as a prostitute, and with the help of a group of neighborhood vigilantes, she gradually tracks down the hit men, their Mafia bosses and her own brother.

programme.title: Precious
programme.desc: Pregnant by her own father for the second time, 16-year-old Claireece "Precious" Jones (Gabourey Sidibe) can neither read nor write and suffers constant abuse at the hands of her vicious mother (Mo'Nique). Precious instinctively sees a chance to turn her life around when she is offered the opportunity to transfer to an alternative school. Under the patient, firm guidance of her new teacher, Ms. Rain (Paula Patton), Precious begins the journey from oppression to self-determination.

programme.title: Street Smart
programme.desc: Jonathan Fisher (Christopher Reeve) is a reporter struggling to keep his job at a magazine. Assigned to write a real-life prostitution exposé, he fails to gain information from his subjects and decides to make up his own story about a pimp. The piece revives his career, but his fictional character turns out to be strangely similar to Fast Black (Morgan Freeman), an actual pimp, who is outraged and demands that Jonathan spill his sources. When the police get involved, matters get even uglier.

programme.title: Mama Flora's Family
programme.desc: A black matriarch instills values of God and family in three generations of 20th-century kin. Adapted from a book by Alex Haley and David Stevens.

programme.desc: Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon).

But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them.

The inmates include Lil' Mamma (Lark Voorhies), a pregnant teen, and Nikki (N'Bushe Wright), the queen bee of Whitehead. The inmates are under the supervision of abusive warden Dease (Clifton Powell), who forces them to endure hours of hard labor, from which he profits. Eventually, the women band together and reach out to part-time prison guard Michael (Mos Def), a law student, who helps them fight for reform.

Unfortunately for the rednecks, Soldier's elite squad specialized in search-and-destroy missions -- and now he will search and destroy once more as he sets out to free his sister.

Inspired by the coming-of-age stories her English teacher (Patricia Arquette) introduces in class, Ansiedad decides to skip adolescence and jump-start her life without her mother. But, when the misguided plan unravels, Ansiedad and Grace must both learn that growing up means acting your age.

programme.title: I Don't Know How She Does It
programme.desc: As an employee at a Boston-based financial firm, Kate Reddy (Sarah Jessica Parker) struggles daily to balance the demands of her high-powered career with the needs of her husband (Greg Kinnear) and children. When she gets an account that requires frequent trips to New York and her husband gets a new job, Kate finds herself spread even thinner. Complicating Kate's life even more is new business associate Jack Abelhammer (Pierce Brosnan), who throws temptation into the mix.

programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

programme.title: Throw Momma From the Train
programme.desc: Larry (Billy Crystal), an author with a cruel ex-wife, Margaret (Kate Mulgrew), teaches a writing workshop where Owen (Danny DeVito), one of his students, is fed up with his domineering mother (Anne Ramsey). When Owen watches a Hitchcock classic that seems to mirror his own life, he decides to put the movie's plot into action and offers to kill Margaret, if Larry promises to murder his mom. Before Larry gets a chance to react to the plan, it seems that Owen has already sealed Margaret's fate.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

She excels in school and cheerleading, and she has a handsome football-playing boyfriend, even though she isn't that crazy about him. So she's stunned when her parents decide she's gay and send her to True Directions, a boot camp meant to alter her sexual orientation. While there, Megan meets a rebellious and unashamed teen lesbian, Graham (Clea DuVall). Though Megan still feels confused, she starts to have feelings for Graham.

programme.desc: A former stripper's (Rebecca Hall) talent with numbers lands her a job with a professional gambler (Bruce Willis) who runs a sports book in Las Vegas.

He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage.

Unfortunately, Tony has set his sights upon Angela -- and so has an undercover FBI agent (Matthew Modine) looking to use her to bust Tony.
